functions.name: hqxInit
functions.description: Initializes the hqX scaling library internals (e.g., lookup tables) prior to using any hq2x/hq3x/hq4x routines. Typical usage: call once during startup, then invoke the scaling functions as needed. Returns no status; failure modes, if any, are not exposed.
requirements: Must be called before any of hq2x_32, hq3x_32, hq4x_32, hq2x_32_rb, hq3x_32_rb, or hq4x_32_rb are used.
May be called exactly once during process lifetime; repeated calls are not documented as safe (unknown).
Thread-safety is unknown; if used from multiple threads, perform initialization in a single-threaded context first.

functions.name: hq2x_32
functions.signature: void hq2x_32(const uint32_t* src, uint32_t* dest, int width, int height);
functions.description: Scales a 32-bit-per-pixel source image by 2x using the hq2x algorithm, writing to a tightly packed destination buffer. Intended for pixel-art upscaling with edge smoothing. The source is treated as a width×height grid of 32-bit pixels; the destination becomes (2×width)×(2×height).
requirements: hqxInit() must have been called before this function.
src must point to a valid, readable buffer of at least (size_t)width * height 32-bit pixels (4 bytes per pixel), tightly packed with row stride width*4 bytes.
dest must point to a valid, writable buffer large enough for (2*width) * (2*height) 32-bit pixels (i.e., 4 * width * height * 4 bytes).
width must be > 0; height must be > 0.
Pointers src and dest must be non-null.
Source and destination buffers must not overlap (overlap safety is unknown).
Pixel format is 32-bit per pixel; exact channel order/endianness is not specified in this header (unknown).
Function returns no status; callers cannot detect errors via return value.

functions.name: hq2x_32_rb
functions.signature: void hq2x_32_rb(const uint32_t* src, uint32_t src_rowBytes, uint32_t* dest, uint32_t dest_rowBytes, int width, int height);
functions.description: Scales a 32-bit-per-pixel source image by 2x using the hq2x algorithm with explicit row stride (rowBytes) parameters. Use when source and/or destination rows are not tightly packed. Destination dimensions are (2×width)×(2×height), with dest_rowBytes specifying the byte stride between rows.
requirements: hqxInit() must have been called before this function.
src must point to a valid, readable buffer containing at least height rows; each row must contain at least width pixels (4*width bytes), with consecutive rows separated by src_rowBytes bytes.
dest must point to a valid, writable buffer for at least 2*height rows; each row must contain at least 2*width pixels (4*2*width bytes), with consecutive rows separated by dest_rowBytes bytes.
width must be > 0; height must be > 0.
src_rowBytes must be >= 4 * width; dest_rowBytes must be >= 4 * (2 * width).
src_rowBytes and dest_rowBytes are in bytes and should be multiples of 4 to align 32-bit pixels (inferred).
Pointers src and dest must be non-null.
Source and destination regions must not overlap (overlap safety is unknown).
Pixel format is 32-bit per pixel; exact channel order/endianness is not specified in this header (unknown).
Function returns no status; callers cannot detect errors via return value.
